newsitem.title: USA: Whitman Corp Q1 net slips as revenues climb.
newsitem.headline: Whitman Corp Q1 net slips as revenues climb.

text.p: Whitman Corp said Thursday earnings in the first quarter nearly matched last year's record levels while its total sales and revenues rose slightly.
The diversified holding company posted net income of $15.5 million or $0.15 a share in the period ended March 31, compared to $16 million or $0.15 a year ago.

Sales and revenues in the period climbed to $674.1 million from $657.9 million in the wake of what Whitman called good investment opportunities during the quarter. They included a refrigeration company in Brazil, soda franchises in Michigan and the launch of bottling operations in Russia, Whitman said.
Whitman shares were off 5/8 Thursday at 23-3/8.
